name: Jason Herring
title: Design Technologist / Principal — Creative Engineer
summary: Principal-level design technologist who ships — I write the code and direct the creative. 20+ years at the seam of design and engineering, now leading AI prototyping on Intuit's Foresight team and carrying that work into production: **Intuit Labs** (labs.intuit.com/ai), **Intuit Labs in QuickBooks**, and the **Delphi** AI business advisor. Conversational and voice interfaces, real-time personality engines, and agentic systems that move from speculative demo to shipped product.
skills: Generative AI, LLMs, RAG & Prompt Engineering
Real-Time Voice Pipelines (Vapi, LiveKit, Hume, HeyGen)

experience.context: Mountain View, CA · Key builder on Foresight, Intuit's 100+ person AI innovation team reporting into the Chief AI Officer org. Promoted Staff → Senior Staff; served as Group Manager (Feb–Jun 2026) before returning to a senior IC leadership track to keep building.

shipped.text: Shipped Intuit's public AI showcase and designed its Delphi page: the entry point into a free guest experience where anyone can upload their own data and get AI business advice without an Intuit account. Public beta to **1M+ international users**.

Shipped the in-product beta surface where new and early-beta AI features go in front of real customers for iteration and experimentation. Live in the UK with global rollout underway — the pipeline that carries Foresight prototypes into shipping product.

Released the first authenticated version inside Intuit Labs in QuickBooks — an AI business advisor built on financial general intelligence, reasoning across a customer's full Intuit data to deliver forward-looking recommendations.
Shipped dictation and voice input into Omni, Intuit's flagship intelligence product — a deliberately light-touch voice experiment on a flagship surface, iterating toward conversational UI.
Building a feedback tool that turns raw customer signal off these surfaces into a loop product teams can act on.

bullets: Designed and built a real-time AI personality engine from scratch — natural language, emotional intelligence, and embodied avatars — on ultra-low-latency voice pipelines (Vapi, Hume, LiveKit, HeyGen).
Delivered flagship demos at executive forums and summits that shifted how leadership invests in AI as a product medium.
Built org-wide AI-literacy workshops (Demystifying Python, Shipping Conversations, AI Avatars & Voice), seeding hands-on fluency across teams.

experience.context: San Francisco, CA · Creative and technical leadership for an enterprise development studio (React, React Native, Node, WordPress).
bullets: Grew annual revenue **85%+** over four years through new-client acquisition and expanded scopes.
Directed a Helix clinical-trials mobile app — notifications, dashboards, and protocol-compliance tools — lifting user-acquisition success **22%**.
Built and led a team of 8 engineers and 3 designers; introduced AI workflows (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion) into design and delivery.

experience.context: San Francisco, CA · Owned design and engineering for Northern California's largest public-media organization.
bullets: Led the multi-year KQED.org redesign and re-platformed a large WordPress CMS to GCP Kubernetes (canary deploys, instant rollbacks), powering hundreds of thousands of articles and partner feeds (NPR, Apple News, Google News).
Shipped automated audio workflows for Alexa, Google Assistant, and NPR One; built real-time 2018 election infrastructure across every Bay Area county.
Redesigned KQED Radio, News, Arts, Science, and the homepage (persistent audio player, real-time trending); election dashboard drew **1M+ views** on 2016 election night.
Shipped one of public media's first single-page apps — the 2016 Voter Guide (WordPress → Elasticsearch + React) — adopted as a model across NPR member stations.

experience.context: San Francisco, CA · Founded and ran an award-winning creative studio for 13 years — a small team pioneering the creative use of technology for brand expression, and a hub of the SF interactive design scene that launched a generation of Bay Area careers.
bullets: Pioneered early Flash and creative-technology work that set a bar for interactive brand expression across sport, skate, fashion, music, and architecture.

Delivered flagship brand work for Nike (Skateboarding, Running, Sportswear), Adidas Skateboarding, and Brita, alongside cultural projects for MoMA, Stüssy, HUF, Tracy Chapman, and Aesop Rock — including the "None Shall Pass" music video.

experience.context: San Francisco, CA · Concurrent with OrdinaryKids.
bullets: Creative-directed the Nike Free visual center — the first public use of real Nike+ data in a campaign — and ran the Nike FuelBand NYC activation (60+ events in 90 days).
